pitch: The party has parachuted a star into a marginal seat and needs someone to stop her landing on anything important.
candidateBlurb: Former management consultant, recently discovered a lifelong love of Harwell. Can say 'stakeholder' in six languages. Has visited the constituency twice, once by mistake.

objectives.label: Reach 40% vote share (the seat was lost by 2,000 votes last time)
Don't let the party's rising star burn out (morale above 30 on election day)

keepMessage: Castellane-Hughes takes the seat and thanks 'the whole team' in a speech that does not mention you by name. The party chair does, privately, twice.
sackMessage: The party chair calls at 2am to say the review will be 'forward-looking'. By 3am your lanyard has stopped opening doors at headquarters.

requires.label: Recognition 12 — the party only calls operators it has heard of
Ruthlessness 70 or below — the party cannot be seen with you
